title: Thunder Eveque - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Where to find the Thunder Eveque in Expedition 33, its elemental weakness, what it drops, and how to handle its lightning attacks.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Breaking Death x2 · Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x5 · Colour of Lumina

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The Thunder Eveque is an optional boss on The Continent and a lightning-flavoured variant of the Eveque. It is one of three elemental Eveque variants in the game, alongside the Flame Eveque (Flying Manor) and Frost Eveque (The Continent).

It is a single, stationary target that hits hard but telegraphs clearly - a good late-game target for testing a damage build.

sections.title: Where to Find the Thunder Eveque
sections.content:
Location: The Continent.

It stands on the eastern side of the map, just above the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave entrance. It is a lone enemy standing in a small field ringed by green and yellow trees - and because it barely moves, it is genuinely easy to fly straight past without noticing.

You need Esquie's flight ability (unlocked in Act 3) to reach this area at all.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toEarth
ResistsIce, Fire, Dark, Light, Physical

Earth is the one opening. Everything else except Void is resisted, which means a generic physical build will feel weak here - bring Earth damage specifically.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Breaking Death x2
  • Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x5
  • Colour of Lumina

sections.title: Strategy
sections.content:
Because it resists almost every damage type, this fight is mostly a build check: if you arrive with Earth damage you will kill it comfortably, and if you do not, it will drag.

Its attacks are lightning-based and, per community reports, its pattern is readable rather than erratic - parry and counter rather than playing defensively. Counterattacks do not care about its resistances, which makes parrying unusually valuable in this particular fight.
